description: After the traveller has paid: one-tap install links for their eSIM, for iPhone (iOS 17.4+) and Android (10+), plus the manual-entry codes. Takes the private eSIM link from the traveller's order confirmation page (https://www.esimpass.com/…/my-esim/…); any other value is refused. Each install link installs the eSIM when opened on the phone that will use it. The result is that traveller's private eSIM details.

esim_link.description: The private eSIM link from the order confirmation page, or the token at its end.

name: get_esim_install

esim_page.description: The traveller's eSIM page: QR code and data usage.

ready.description: false while the eSIM is still being prepared; try again in a minute.

title: Install a purchased eSIM
